- src/rules/helpers/require-story-visitors.ts - All visitor builders annotated with @story docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md and granular REQ-* IDs. - buildVisitors(context, sourceCode, options) merges: * FunctionDeclaration visitor: uses options.shouldProcessNode and helperReportMissing. * FunctionExpression visitor: respects options.shouldProcessNode, skips MethodDefinition parents, uses helperReportMissing. * ArrowFunctionExpression visitor: uses options.shouldProcessNode and helperReportMissing. - Since DEFAULT_SCOPE used by shouldProcessNode does not include "ArrowFunctionExpression", arrows are ignored by default, satisfying the story requirement that arrows are excluded by default. * TSDeclareFunction visitor: uses options.shouldProcessNode and helperReportMissing. * TSMethodSignature visitor: uses options.shouldProcessNode and helperReportMissing. * MethodDefinition visitor: uses options.shouldProcessNode and helperReportMethod.
@req annotation detection and TypeScript support: - src/utils/annotation-checker.ts - Annotated with @story docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md and multiple @req entries (REQ-ANNOTATION-GET-JSDOC, REQ-ANNOTATION-LEADING-COMMENTS, REQ-ANNOTATION-REQ-DETECTION, REQ-TYPESCRIPT-SUPPORT, etc.). - JSDoc/comment parsing for @req (REQ-JSDOC-PARSING equivalent): * getJsdocComment(sourceCode, node) → sourceCode.getJSDocComment(node). * getLeadingComments(node) → node.leadingComments || []. * getCommentsBefore(sourceCode, node) → sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) || []. * combineComments merges leading and before comments. * commentContainsReq(c) checks c.value.includes("@req"). - Multi-heuristic detection for @req (REQ-ANNOTATION-REQ-DETECTION, error handling): * linesBeforeHasReq(sourceCode, node): uses LOOKBACK_LINES (imported) and scans preceding lines for "@req"; includes guards on sourceCode.lines and node.loc; returns false if missing data. * parentChainHasReq(sourceCode, node): walks parent chain, checking getCommentsBefore(p) and p.leadingComments for "@req". * fallbackTextBeforeHasReq(sourceCode, node): uses node.range and FALLBACK_WINDOW with guards and try/catch to search text before the node for "@req". * hasReqAnnotation(jsdoc, comments, context?, node?): - Uses context.getSourceCode() if available, and calls linesBeforeHasReq, parentChainHasReq, fallbackTextBeforeHasReq inside try/catch. - Falls back to checking jsdoc.value.includes("@req") or comments.some(commentContainsReq). - Reporting and error location for @req (REQ-ERROR-LOCATION, User Experience, Error Handling): * reportMissing(context, node, enableFix = true): - Uses getNodeName(node) to derive a human-readable function name; falls back to "(anonymous)". - Selects nameNode as node.id or node.key Identifier when present, else node. - Calls context.report({ node: nameNode, messageId: "missingReq", data: { name, functionName: name } }) and conditionally adds fix when enableFix is true. * checkReqAnnotation(context, node, { enableFix }): - Gathers jsdoc and comments via helpers, calls hasReqAnnotation. - If !hasReq, calls reportMissing(context, node, enableFix). * In require-req-annotation, checkReqAnnotation is invoked with enableFix: false, so missing @req annotations are reported but not auto-fixed, matching story focus on validation rather than auto-fix.

traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are implemented:
- Core Functionality: require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation both apply to the same function-like constructs defined in DEFAULT_SCOPE (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature). Arrow functions are not part of DEFAULT_SCOPE and thus are excluded by default, explicitly validated by tests. - Quality Standards: Rules follow ESLint best practices—RuleModule shape, meta.docs, messageIds, schema validation, and use of shared helpers. RuleTester-based suites exist for both rules, with clear scenario coverage. - Integration: Both rules operate on JavaScript and TypeScript constructs. TSDeclareFunction and TSMethodSignature are handled in visitors and tested using @typescript-eslint/parser. - User Experience: Error messages for missing @story and missing @req are clear, include function names, and suggest the required annotations with concrete examples. Error locations are anchored on function identifiers or method keys when available. - Error Handling: JSDoc and comment parsing is guarded via type checks and try/catch in both @story and @req detection helpers, avoiding crashes on malformed comments or incomplete source metadata while still correctly treating such cases as missing annotations when appropriate. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-story-annotation.md and docs/rules/require-req-annotation.md describe node coverage, options, semantics, and provide examples, and they are explicitly linked to this story via @story and @req tags.
Given the direct traceability annotations in code, the shared helper design ensuring consistent detection and scope semantics across both rules, the presence of comprehensive RuleTester suites aligned with the story, and the supporting documentation, this story is fully implemented and therefore marked PASSED.
